note: Five-bus study system with the topology of the PJM 5-bus training case. Reactances are rounded so that 1/x is a whole number, which keeps the certificates small enough to read by eye; the largest change is under 1 percent of the original value.

request.name: 300 MW interconnection request at bus E
request.description: A new 300 MW resource at bus E. The rest of the dispatch is not a single point: loads carry forecast error and the existing units are free within their operating ranges, so the study is over a box of dispatches rather than one snapshot.
